originalGroup.title: Scheduled network maintenance
originalGroup.passage: This is a notice from the information technology team. The engineering file server will be unavailable this Saturday from nine in the morning until noon while we replace a storage controller. Please save your work and close all files on that server before eight forty-five. Email and the customer support website will remain available. After maintenance, reconnect using the same server address. If a project folder is missing, contact the help desk instead of creating a replacement folder.
originalGroup.passageZh: 這是資訊團隊的通知。工程檔案伺服器將在本星期六上午九點至中午暫停使用，以便更換儲存控制器。請在八點四十五分前保存工作，並關閉該伺服器上的所有檔案。電子郵件與客戶支援網站仍可使用。維護後請使用相同伺服器位址重新連線。如果找不到專案資料夾，請聯絡服務台，不要自行建立替代資料夾。

options.text: The company is moving to another city.

options.text: All project files are being permanently deleted.
options.zh: 所有專案檔案將永久刪除。
options.whyZh: 沒有永久刪除安排。

options.text: A customer requested a new website design.
options.whyZh: 客戶支援網站會照常運作，與此次原因不同。
